cookies.description:
Optional. Leave empty to scrape anonymously. Paste your own Instagram cookies in JSON format to also retry age-restricted and login-protected posts with your account; posts your account still cannot open keep their status, and a private post opens only if your account follows that account. It is a secret input, so the Apify Console hides and encrypts it.

Format: [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}, ...]
cookies.title: Instagram Cookies (Optional)

post_urls.description: Instagram post, reel or IGTV URLs to scrape. Accepts /p/, /reel/, /reels/, /tv/, and canonical username/p/shortcode formats. Duplicates are silently de-duplicated.
post_urls.title: Post URLs
